response.justification: Bogdan brings well over a decade of broad, polyglot engineering experience with a CS degree and some genuinely relevant depth — notably low-latency microservices at Sociomantic handling millions of HTTP requests per second, C/C++ work at National Instruments, and strong software-craftsmanship habits (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered specifically on growth and experimentation systems: A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, telemetry and metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, bias detection, and rollout-risk management. The resume shows essentially none of this domain experience, no data/statistics aptitude, and no evidence of the cross-organizational, multi-workstream technical leadership expected at IC6 within a large enterprise — most roles have been at startups or small consultancies as an individual or small-team contributor. He could be a strong senior/staff generalist hire, but is a weak match for this specific mandate.
strengths: 14+ years of experience across C/C++, Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, plus a CS degree
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong testing/quality culture — TDD, CI/CD, authored test tooling, teaches workshops and mentors
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flighting platform experience
No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data-analysis track record
Limited evidence of IC6-level cross-team architectural influence at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Depth of general engineering experience and scale
